scientific_integrity: The limiting-abundance formula follows from an analytic comparison proof and a triangular change of time. Finite integrations are corroborative and do not substitute for proof. Research-priority uncertainty remains under alternate model terminology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns deterministic, well-mixed, strictly positive initial populations with common reproduction/mortality and positive chain predation. It does not cover heterogeneous demographic parameters, zero edges, missing initially seeded species or finite stochastic populations.
title: Universal odd-level coexistence and predation-scale invariance in hierarchical ecological chains
